svg.title: Shop contexts
svg.desc: Nodes: Catalog (context); Identity (context); Ordering (context); Billing (context); Shipping (context); Card payments (context, External); Support (context). Edges: Catalog (open host service, published language) is upstream of Ordering (conformist): Products. Identity (open host service) is upstream of Ordering (anticorruption layer). Ordering supplies Billing: Orders to invoice. Ordering (published language) supplies Shipping. Card payments (open host service, published language) is upstream of Billing (anticorruption layer). Billing and Shipping share a kernel: Addresses. Ordering and Support are partners.
